blocks.text: Filipino culinary creativity meets all-American comfort food as The Bistro Group recently opened the doors of SIKLAB+ and Denny’s in Quezon City, bringing two distinct dining experiences together under one roof along Kalayaan Avenue in Diliman. The grand opening was made even more exciting by the appearance of Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray, who turned up the heat with her world-famous Lava Walk before joining the VIPs for the opening ceremony. Singer Bugoy Drilon also delighted guests with a performance of his much-loved songs, adding a musical highlight to the celebration.
